blockedReasons: The shared source inventory does not qualify either product image; current full image, voice, telephony and hardware acceptance remain separate gates.
Platform, APK, AVB and OTA release signing plus update and recovery evidence have not been admitted for this target.
The common hardware product and privilege configuration for both launcher brands remains separate work.
targets.decisionNote: Uses the exact Alpha Phone Pixel 10a/stallion source-input inventory. Its source admission is retained, while releaseQualified remains false. Recorded Alpha manifest and product names are immutable provenance, not the Eliza launcher identity.

blockedReasons: A complete reproducible device-kernel and vendor-module integration is not yet verified; initial bring-up intentionally uses the stock kernel extracted from the pinned factory image.
The generated vendor module has not yet completed an exact-source build and physical Pixel 11 Pro boot validation.
No retained Pixel 11 Pro rollback, flash, post-boot hardware, launcher, local inference, or voice evidence bundle exists yet.
targets.decisionNote: Alpha Phone (#31023) names Pixel 10 as the target and allows Pixel 11 only after support is validated. This tree has no Pixel 10 (frankel/blazer/mustang) lock. Pixel 10a (stallion) is a distinct source profile and does not qualify grizzly or those Pixel 10 models. Keep this target unvalidated until either the Pixel 11 Pro evidence above exists or a Pixel 10 lock, brand config and vendor product are added.

blockedReasons: No physical device has been qualified: there is no retained flash, boot, VINTF compatibility, rollback, launcher, local inference, or voice evidence for any MediaTek tablet running this GSI.
The tablet maker's vendor, ODM, boot and kernel partitions are third-party binaries that cannot be reproduced from pinned source.
Third-party MediaTek bootloaders require Android Verified Boot verification to be disabled with an unlocked (orange) boot state, a weaker trust state than a locked device with an enrolled key.
Protection of radio-frequency calibration and parameters below the OS (bootloader, modem and vendor firmware) has not been verified for any candidate device.
A production user build is blocked: the on-device agent depends on a userdebug-only SELinux rule that lets platform_app execute app data files.
targets.decisionNote: generic_arm64 is the PRODUCT_DEVICE of the eliza_gsi_arm64 system image, not a tablet codename; on a GSI, ro.product.device comes from the tablet's vendor partition. Each qualified tablet needs its own target with its real codename, vendor API level, kernel version and VINTF evidence.

blockedReasons: Light's official light-sdk is an application/tool SDK, not a bootable LightOS/AOSP source, signing, or flash contract.
No authoritative AOSP device tree or board configuration has been published.
No kernel source or boot-image contract has been published.
No licensed vendor-blob manifest has been published.
No validated bootloader unlock, flash, or rollback procedure exists.

targets.marketingName: Lenovo Idea Tab / Tab K11 Gen 2 Wi-Fi
blockedReasons: Read-only stock Android 16 observation is not an Eliza or downstream GSI boot; no exact-image VINTF, boot, hardware, runtime or rollback qualification exists.
Community Android 16 GSI success on Lenovo 17.5.10.271 does not qualify the Eliza Android 17 GSI or other Lenovo SKUs.
The observed device remains locked. Device-specific Lenovo unlock authorization, stock restore inputs and an installation contract are not provisioned.
Matching Lenovo kernel/vendor/DTBO/module source and a custom-key relock contract have not been verified. Community installers retain stock binaries and disable AVB verification.
targets.decisionNote: TB336FU / sycamore_row_wifi is the Wi-Fi model. TB336ZU, TB336ZA and TB335FC are not interchangeable. Keep downstream UI and product policy in the consumer; use stage-launcher-overlay with partition system for a system-only image.
